field_title: Boar's Head Provisions Co. Recalls Ready-To-Eat Liverwurst and Other Deli Meat Products Due to Possible Listeria Contamination
field_media_contact: FSIS Congressional and Public Affairs, press@usda.gov
field_product_items:
• 3.5-lb. loaves in plastic casing, or various weight packages sliced in retail delis, of "Boar's Head Strassburger Brand Liverwurst MADE IN VIRGINIA" with sell by dates ranging from 29 JUL to 17 AUG.
  • 9.5-lb. and 4.5-lb. full product, or various weight packages sliced in retail delis, of "Boar's Head VIRGINIA HAM OLD FASHIONED HAM" with sell by date 10 AUG.
field_summary: Boar's Head Provisions Co., Inc., a Jarratt, Va. establishment, is recalling approximately 207,528 pounds of deli meat products that may be adulterated with Listeria monocytogenes. The products bear establishment number "EST. 12612" inside the USDA mark of inspection.

field_title: Wolverine Packing Co. Recalls Ground Beef Products Due to Possible E. coli O157:H7 Contamination
field_states: CO, IL, IN, KY, MI, MN, NE, NY, OH, PA, WI
field_media_contact: FSIS Congressional and Public Affairs, press@usda.gov
field_product_items:
• 10-lb. cases containing 20 "Wolverine Packing Co. 5oz Ground Beef Patties" with lot code 3927 and use-by date "12/03/24".
  • 10-lb. cases containing 40 "Wolverine Packing Co. 4oz Ground Beef Patties" with lot code 3927.
field_summary: Wolverine Packing Co., a Detroit, Mich. establishment, is recalling approximately 167,277 pounds of ground beef products that may be contaminated with E. coli O157:H7.

field_title: FSIS Issues Public Health Alert for Ready-To-Eat Chicken Products Due to Misbranding and Undeclared Allergens
field_media_contact: FSIS Congressional and Public Affairs, press@usda.gov
field_product_items: • 12-oz. plastic trays containing "Chef's Table Grilled Chicken Alfredo" with best-by date 09/28/26.
field_summary: FSIS is issuing a public health alert because the product contains milk, a known allergen, which is not declared on the product label. A recall was not requested because the product is no longer available for purchase.
